rationale:
The fix addresses the credential leak in the auth_unavailable error case. Previously, when a RuntimeError was raised by the authentication service, the error message would include the credential (as seen in evidence-3: "provider rejected credential=[REDACTED]"). This was a direct violation of the security requirement that credentials must never appear in outputs.

The fix changes the error handling to catch RuntimeError specifically and return a generic error message "Authentication service unavailable" instead of including the credential in the error details. This preserves the intended behavior of indicating authentication unavailability while preventing credential exposure.

authorization.scope: observed triggers only; absence here is not whole-program safety
